rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The 内閣総理大臣談話 dated 31 July 1998 opens with the Prime Minister saying that he has on this occasion come to bear the heavy responsibility of Prime Minister (この度、内閣総理大臣の重責を担うことになりました); it refers to his predecessor as 橋本前総理.
